scope: Additive TH18 regular Wall Breaker L1-L14 direct-parent Wall-target baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3 for the current parent table; the official notes and community mechanics page do not publish a Wall Breaker-specific current client build.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes
sources.limitations: Officially confirms Wall Breaker level 10 at TH14 but not the later L11-L14 values, Wall multiplier, splash radius, self-destruction, pathing or exact target selection.

sources.title: Wall Breaker — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports L1-L14 HP/DPS, L14 TH18, housing 2, ground-only target, one-second cadence, melee and Wall focus. It describes the protected-unreached-building intent but does not define deterministic wall choice, pathing, collision, blast timing, radius boundary or ties.

sources.title: Wall Breaker
sources.limitations: The frozen reference records its ×40 Wall multiplier, two-tile splash and intentional destruction after successful attack; it has no current build identifier or complete deterministic topology/timing specification.

support.note: The L1-L14 Wall-targeting parent uses the existing shared Core ×40 Wall impact, two-tile splash and post-impact self-destruction route; Headless, Viewer and RL consume immutable GameData.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent although current values, Wall preference and historical secondary special-impact evidence exist in the frozen reference.
changed_values.replacement: The shared Core Wall-target route is explicitly exercised at L14 with the source-recorded ×40 Wall impact, two-tile area and post-impact self-destruction through focused Core, snapshot/replay and Headless CLI coverage.
changed_values.justification: The build-pinned current table establishes L1-L14 and the parent role; existing secondary provenance establishes the multiplier, area and destruction behavior. No protected-Wall topology, collision or timing rule is introduced.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines which Wall protects which unreached building, route topology, collision, blast-boundary metric, target loss, same-tick ordering or tie breaking. Core distance then entity-ID choice is a deterministic simulator rule, not asserted as client fidelity.
No consulted source defines launch/wind-up, blast timing, death-before-impact behavior, target area ordering, interactions, projectile semantics or visual animation timing.
The current L1-L14 direct values are secondary. The official note confirms only L10, and the ×40/splash/self-destruction mechanics remain secondary and version-unknown.
conclusion: Wall Breaker L1-L14 is executable through shared Core, Headless, Viewer and RL as a ground Wall-target parent with source-recorded ×40 Wall impact, two-tile area and post-impact self-destruction. Protected-Wall choice, pathing, collision, timing and visual fidelity remain partial.
